{{Event Infobox
| Name  = Forgotten Altar
| Image = Event-ForgottenAltar.png
}} {{Small Relic Infobox|Bloody Idol}} {{Small Card Infobox|Decay}}
{{E|Forgotten Altar}} is an [[Event]] found exclusively in [[Act 2]]. This Event is the only way to obtain {{R|Bloody Idol}}. It is one of the events affected by {{Asc|15|Ascension}}.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Offer: Golden Idol}} {{TS|positive||Obtain a special}} {{R|Bloody Idol|Relic}}{{TS|positive||.}} {{TS|negative||Lose}} {{R|Golden Idol}}{{TS|negative||.}}
* If the player does not have {{R|Golden Idol}}, this option is replaced with {{Frame|Locked}} Requires: Golden Idol.

{{Frame|Sacrifice}} {{TS|positive||Gain 5 Max HP.}} {{TS|negative||Lose X HP.}}
* X is equal to 25% {{Asc|15|(35%)}} of the player's Max HP.

{{Frame|Desecrate}} {{TS|negative||Become Cursed -}}{{C|Decay}}{{TS|negative||.}}
* {{C|Decay}} - {{KW|Unplayable}}. At the end of your turn, take 2 damage.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
In front of you sits an altar to a forgotten god.
<br>
Atop the altar sits an ornate female statue with arms outstretched.
<br>
She calls out to you, demanding sacrifice.
</div><br><br>

{{Frame|Offer: Golden Idol}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
As you gently set the idol onto the altar a {{TS|blue||cold}} wind swirls throughout the room.
<br>
The arms of the statue begin to discolor and crumble.
<br><br>
Your {{TS|gold||golden idol}} begins to dull in color and begins bleeding from its eyes.
<br>
The bleeding never ceases.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Sacrifice}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You stand on the altar and cut your wrists.
<br>
As the {{TS|negative||blood}} spills out in sacrifice, the arms of the statue reach out and close around your eyes.
<br>
Everything goes dark.
<br>
You wake up a short time later feeling a new potential surging through you.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Desecrate}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You lash out and smash the statue in front of you, breaking the magical hold the room had placed upon you.
<br>
A dark wail echoes all around you, and you can feel the {{TS|purple|up|cursed magic}} seep into your bones.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Notes ==
* {{R|Golden Idol}} is only obtained from the {{E|Golden Idol}} Event.
* If the {{R|Golden Idol}} is turned into the {{R|Bloody Idol}}, {{E|The Moai Head}} Event in Act 3 will no longer accept it as an offering.

== Update History ==
* '''Weekly Patch 5: Happy Holidays!'''
** Forgotten Altar now gives you the Max HP before damaging you. This way you won't die if the damage hits you first.

* '''Weekly Patch 4: Full speed ahead!'''
** Forgotten altar displays correct HP loss for the Silent now.
